91xpressrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Sandisk Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results News Summary • Fiscal first quarter revenue was $11.0 billion, up 23% sequentially, with GAAP net income reported at $8.1 billion ($52.60 diluted net income per share, up 20% sequentially). First quarter Non-GAAP diluted net income per share was $49.51. • Returned $5.0 billion to stockholders through the repurchase of approximately 3.2 million shares during the quarter. Over the past two fiscal quarters, repurchased 6.0 million shares, representing approximately 4% of total shares outstanding. • Announced today an eight-for-one forward stock split, effective November 19, 2026, to make stock more accessible, including to employees through its employee stock purchase plan. • Expect second quarter 2027 revenue to be in the range of $12.2 billion to $12.6 billion, with expected Non-GAAP diluted net income per share on a pre-split basis in the range of $55.00 to $57.00 1 . MILPITAS, Calif. — October 29, 2026 — Sandisk Corporation (Nasdaq: SNDK) today reported fiscal first quarter financial results. "We have started fiscal year 2027 with another quarter of strong performance, with robust and growing demand for our products driving outpaced growth in our data center business," said David Goeckeler, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Sandisk. "We are executing on the strategy that we outlined at Investor Day, delivering growing and durable free cash flow through our technology leadership, deep customer partnerships, and disciplined financial management."
